limitations_and_boundaries: The study focuses on zebrafish embryos; generalizability to other vertebrates is implied but not directly tested.
The foam model assumes a 3D-disordered monodispersed foam, which may not capture all complexities of living tissues.
Blebbistatin treatment is a partial inhibition of myosin II; complete loss-of-function effects were not examined.
The causal chain from N-cadherin gradient to jamming is supported by mutant and inhibitor experiments, but direct manipulation of extracellular volume fraction was not performed.
Measurements are limited to the posterior body axis; anterior elongation mechanisms may differ.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

methods.name: Magnetic droplet actuation yield stress measurement
methods.protocol_description: A controlled, uniform magnetic field was applied for 15 min to droplets previously inserted in the tissue, causing large deformations (>1 cell size, 50–150% strain). After field removal, droplets relaxed towards a spherical shape due to interfacial tension but arrested before reaching it, revealing a residual deformation. Yield stress was calculated from the residual deformation and known capillary stress.
